description: Collaboration tools exposed to agents via MCP server

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a markdown message to the other agent in the collaboration

content.description: Markdown content of the message to send

message_path.description: Absolute path to the created message file

errors.description: Content is empty or invalid UTF-8
Failed to write message file to disk

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read all messages from the other agent, optionally filtered by turn number

since_turn.description: Only return messages from turns >= this value. Omit to get all messages.

messages.description: Array of messages from the other agent

errors.description: Message file has invalid YAML frontmatter

tools.name: write_shared_context
tools.description: Overwrite the shared collaboration context file with new content. Both agents can read and write this file.

tools.name: read_shared_context
tools.description: Read the current content of the shared collaboration context file

errors.description: Failed to read shared_context.md (file may not exist yet)

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Overwrite this agent's private memory file with new content. Only this agent can read/write this file.

content.description: New markdown content for this agent's memory.md

path.description: Absolute path to this agent's memory file

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Read the current content of this agent's private memory file

content.description: Current markdown content of this agent's memory.md

path.description: Absolute path to this agent's memory file

errors.description: Failed to read memory file (file may not exist yet)

tools.name: submit_deliverable
tools.description: Submit the final collaboration deliverable with approval. Session completes when both agents submit identical content with approval=true.

approved.description: Whether this agent approves this deliverable. Must be true.

status.description: pending if waiting for other agent, completed if both approved

errors.description: Content is empty, approved is false, or invalid UTF-8
Both agents submitted but content doesn't match exactly

notes: Agents can submit multiple times (latest submission replaces previous)
Content must match byte-for-byte (including whitespace) for completion
Session transitions to 'completed' status when both agents submit matching content
If max_turns reached without matching submissions, session becomes 'incomplete'

server_lifecycle.startup: MCP server starts when session begins, before agent processes spawn
server_lifecycle.connection: Each agent connects via STDIO transport, receives server endpoint via environment variable
server_lifecycle.shutdown: Server terminates gracefully when session ends or encounters critical error

concurrency_model: Single MCP server handles requests from both agents sequentially (agents alternate turns, so no concurrent tool calls)
event_emission: All tool invocations emit ToolInvoked events to EventBus for logging and TUI updates
